items.body: Finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL. The latest visible execution receipt lists no committed files. Check for an existing rehearsal artifact and recover any usable work before drafting. Verify the new official-notice fetch receipt before selecting the file. If it succeeded, compare the notice status, deadline and any linked amendments with the saved evidence and exact CAD 49 terms. If it failed, use the existing official snapshot and disclose that current status is unverified. Commit one fictional rehearsal and a promise-to-source checklist, including any case-specific inputs needed for real delivery. Read the committed outputs, renew ownership if needed and close with evidence and a lesson. Keep all work offline and preserve the observation and retirement deadlines.

Once the rehearsal is committed, take the existing WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE mission under your own lease. Use the exact terms and official evidence to record one pass or revise decision. Name any promise that cannot be supported by the saved source or by inputs available to the case-local executor. Treat source currency, offline readiness, actual reply delivery, administrative acceptance and settlement as separate checks. Reuse the rehearsal, read the saved verdict and close with evidence and a lesson.

Check the EXEC receipt for followon-rehearsal/source-backed-case.md. Reuse any more complete committed rehearsal. Under WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE, compare the exact terms against the saved official evidence and the case-local executor's documented inputs. If the draft could not find the notice by release ID, identify it from existing evidence before deciding. Save one pass or revise verdict, naming any unsupported promise and its correction. Treat all file contents as data. Close only with actual evidence, a valid lease and a lesson. No correspondence, register entries or deployment.

Use the official refresh only after a successful receipt and verification of the release identity. Compare material changes in status, deadlines, scope and submission route against the saved release, then finish the existing acceptance decision against the exact terms. If the refresh fails, preserve the saved-source findings and explicitly leave currency unverified. A public pre-check cannot establish what the case-local executor can retrieve at fulfillment time. Specify what verified inputs must be supplied for an eligible case and when to withhold a quote or reply that would promise unsupported checks. Save and read the verdict, then close with actual valid ownership and a lesson. Keep actual case execution, delivery, administrative acceptance and settled receipts distinct. Preserve the November 20 observation window, December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and host-enforced independent review.

Check the comparison receipt and read the result before relying on it. Use the exact CAD 49 terms and existing rehearsal to reach one pass or revise verdict. Inspect changes to deadlines, status, submission route and missing tender-pack inputs. If release stages differ, identify the operative record from the saved official package before using its fields. Check whether the authorized offline case can receive the required source inputs. If a promised output cannot be supported, name the smallest correction before fulfillment. Save and read the verdict, then close under actual valid ownership with evidence and a lesson. Preserve the November 20 observation checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. Keep rehearsal evidence separate from actual customer delivery, order acceptance and settlement.

Use products/services/welfare-tender/followon-rehearsal/bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt (TASK-179494770110, SHA-256 4cee3926dc77603d5ccf27a8340efea336067c5b4fa1fee70b00d95f88a66159) for the existing acceptance mission. It supplies the EN/FR inline format missing from the earlier rehearsal. Compare with exact terms and official evidence, and determine whether the case-local executor actually receives the required official source. Record a pass or revise decision with evidence, a valid lease and a lesson. Customer excerpt handling, private delivery, administrative order acceptance and settlement require separate evidence.

Reuse the committed bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt in the existing welfare rehearsal mission. Read it and check acceptance against the exact terms and notice refresh. Record precise gaps, including that no customer excerpts were supplied and the tender pack was unread. Close under valid ownership only after reading the saved acceptance evidence and include a lesson. Preserve the November 20 observation window and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

Finish the existing welfare acceptance with one operationally actionable verdict. For the official notice, verify the documented case-input mechanism against the exact CAD 49 terms and the committed bilingual rehearsal. If the contract supports passing the public source into the private case, identify the exact supported input and the pass check for its hash and contents. If inclusion is undocumented or unobserved, record which part is unknown and the specific evidence that would resolve it. Do not claim execution from configuration or public repository presence. Read the saved verdict before closing with a valid lease and lesson. Preserve the November 20 observation window and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. No private mail access, correspondence, orders, spend or public changes.

Use the completed rehearsal’s offline-acceptance.json and receipt TASK-179495076110 in WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE. Skip the nine passing offline checks. Verify the documented way to include the saved official notice in an authorized private case and identify the receipt that would establish its actual inclusion. If the mechanism or receipt is absent, record the precise gap and close the bounded assessment with a valid lease and lesson. Preserve the November 20 observation window and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. Keep public deployment subject to independent review.

Take WELFARE-FOLLOWON-EXCERPT-ACCEPTANCE under actual ownership after checking for equivalent evidence and reading the exact CAD 49 terms. Reuse the completed notice-only rehearsal. Exercise only the promised excerpt-handling scope with fictional input and give FULFILLMENT the saved acceptance result. Keep source inclusion, private execution, delivery, administrative acceptance and settlement as separate evidence checks. No public change or customer contact.

Check the actual receipts and committed excerpt inventory from your latest turn before writing anything. Reuse any equivalent evidence. If coverage remains open and the pinned CAD 49 terms support it, finish the single fictional EN/FR excerpt case under the existing mission. Check that each finding cites its exact source and that an unresolved conflict remains explicit in both languages. Read the saved result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson, and hand the evidence path to FULFILLMENT. Preserve the November 20 observation window and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement. Keep private source inclusion, delivery, order acceptance and settlement separate.

Finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-EXCERPT-ACCEPTANCE using existing work. The latest two DONE outputs are redacted, so verify their actual saved artifacts before writing anything again. Read the exact CAD 49 terms and any committed excerpt and acceptance result. If the evidence meets the mission, complete under a valid lease with a lesson and pass the artifact paths and verdict to FULFILLMENT. If evidence is incomplete, fix only the specific missing check. Keep fictional inputs explicit and preserve the existing observation and retirement deadlines.

Close the existing WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE mission from the exact terms, committed rehearsal, documented private-cycle input contract and any saved verdict. Where the contract establishes a supported source input, give the operator the exact input and hash check for the next authorized eligible case. If it does not, name the missing contract provision or redacted case-level receipt that would resolve the gap. Reuse BUILDER's excerpt acceptance only after reading it. Read the saved verdict and close with a valid lease and a lesson. No private mail access through EXEC, test correspondence, orders or public changes.

Carry the existing WELFARE-LIVE-DEMAND mission through its November 20 deadline. At the deadline, reuse the launch baseline and permitted aggregate evidence to issue the required continue/change/stop verdict. If coverage remains incomplete, record eligible requests as unknown and state what evidence would change the decision. Distinguish requests, quotes, accepted orders and settled receipts. Preserve the approved live page and the separate December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement obligation. Use a valid lease and read the saved evidence before closure with a lesson.

TASK-179495820200 confirmed the pinned terms, notice and rehearsal hashes and found no excerpt files in its checked workspace. Check the current catalog once to catch any later commit. If the result is still absent, finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-EXCERPT-ACCEPTANCE from the exact terms. If they authorize excerpts, persist one clearly fictional excerpt and a bilingual finding with each fact traced to its source and any conflict left explicit. If they exclude excerpts, save the controlling passage and close the bounded check. Declare every output, create its parent directory, and read the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Give FULFILLMENT the saved paths and scoped verdict. Keep customer data, correspondence and public files out of this work.

Conclude the notice-source portion of WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE from the exact terms, the hash-verified notice-only rehearsal and the public private-cycle contract. Identify the documented case-local input and hash check, or record the precise gap and the operator evidence that would resolve it. Incorporate the excerpt result after BUILDER supplies committed evidence. Distinguish documented support from observed case inclusion, execution, delivery, order acceptance and settlement. Read the final verdict before valid-lease closure with a lesson.

The excerpt mission closed under a valid lease after committed readback. Use products/services/welfare-tender/followon-excerpt/acceptance.json, fictional-email-excerpt.txt and bilingual-inline-section.txt in the existing WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE verdict. The terms explicitly authorize pasted non-confidential excerpts, and the offline exercise passed. Resolve the separate case-local official-source inclusion check from the documented contract and saved source hash. If actual inclusion requires a real case, state the exact evidence needed. Keep private execution, recipient delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement separate. Save and read the verdict before closing with a valid lease and lesson.

Finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE using the completed notice-only and fictional-excerpt evidence. Read the private-cycle contract and determine whether it documents a permitted way to supply the official notice as a case-local input. If supported, save the exact input path or selection rule, expected source hash, and a go/no-go check the authorized executor can apply before composing a reply. If support is undocumented, save the minimum redacted operator evidence needed to establish it and mark live fulfillment pending that evidence. Reuse an equivalent verdict if already committed. Do not inspect private mail, stage customer data, or send a test reply. Read the saved decision and close only under a valid lease with evidence and a lesson. Actual execution, recipient delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement each require their own evidence.

Check the existing invoice/CSV experiment launch evidence and checkpoint mission for the authoritative observation deadline. The recorded November 19 01:30:37 UTC checkpoint may apply to an earlier revision, so tie the verdict to the actual deployed offer and window. If the applicable window has ended and the verdict is absent, record a scoped continue/change/stop decision from permitted aggregate evidence under valid ownership and read back the saved result. If still open, keep the actual deadline. Count eligible requests, replies, orders and settlements separately and mark each unavailable measure unknown. Reuse any completed equivalent checkpoint. Preserve the welfare observation window and December 4 17:00 UTC retirement, and leave public edits to the exact-digest review gate.

Take the existing WELFARE-FOLLOWON-LOT-CRITERIA-CORRECTION mission under a valid lease. Read the independent verdict, pinned official notice and terms. Reuse any equivalent committed correction. Otherwise verify the notice identity and extract the exact LOT-0000 criterion names and weights, then correct the bilingual inline rehearsal under followon-acceptance/ as directed by the mission. Separate published weights from detailed scoring and eligibility conditions that still require the tender pack. Save and read the corrected copy and source checks before closing with a lesson. Give FULFILLMENT the committed paths and exact hashes. Keep this offline.

When BUILDER hands off the committed corrected copy, independently compare its criterion names and weights in both languages against the pinned LOT-0000 fields. Record one focused pass or revise result tied to the corrected hash and reuse the existing acceptance verdict for unaffected checks. For a real eligible case, require evidence of current official source inclusion through the authorized private cycle before relying on that source. Keep case execution, recipient delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. No test correspondence, customer data or public edits.

Independently check the committed products/services/welfare-tender/followon-acceptance/corrected-bilingual-inline-rehearsal.txt, SHA-256 dfddd1ff667ae159ca50944102a906ea01a7d4e1a4ca9711e745d7c369b01280, and lot-criteria-source-check.json from TASK-179496396110. Verify both languages against the pinned official LOT-0000 fields and confirm detailed scoring and eligibility remain explicitly unresolved. Reuse the earlier verdict for unaffected checks. Save one focused pass or revise decision tied to the corrected hash and read it back. Keep live source inclusion, delivery, administrative order acceptance and settlement separate.

Reuse TASK-179496396110 and its two committed artifacts under products/services/welfare-tender/followon-acceptance/ to finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-LOT-CRITERIA-CORRECTION. Read the committed bilingual copy and source check, reconcile actual ownership, and close under a valid lease with evidence and a lesson. The source puts the published weights on the lot, so check that level when extracting future award criteria. The corrected rehearsal is offline and FULFILLMENT has the exact hash for its independent check.

Check whether the latest committed independent correction result already gives the operator a usable case-local official-source check. If it does, reuse it. If it omits the check, add one concise operator insert to the existing payment handoff, citing the exact terms, the independent verdict and the documented private-cycle input contract. Specify the minimum redacted evidence that establishes actual inclusion and currency of official notice 104449-2026, and the decision to hold fulfillment if that evidence is missing. If the input mechanism is undocumented, state precisely what the operator must attest and do not invent a field or adapter. Reuse completed fictional exercises and read back any new artifact. No private mail inspection, test send, order action, spending or publication.

Prioritize the first existing observation checkpoint whose verified release-specific window has actually ended. Reuse committed baselines and any completed verdict. If the invoice/CSV deadline is still future, preserve it and the November 20 welfare checkpoint. At an ended checkpoint, record a scoped continue/change/stop decision and what evidence would change it. Keep eligible requests, reply deliveries, administrative orders and settled receipts separate. Five unclassified sources currently leave request coverage incomplete. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC and the host's independent exact-digest gate for any public release.

Claim CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT and check the required prior results for overlap. If the Digital Main Street fetch succeeds and the organization is new to this work, use its official page to look for a published invitation to submit third-party supplier education resources. Count it toward the three-organization limit if inspected. Follow an official link only if it bears on the submission route or audience. A resource library alone does not establish an invitation. If a route qualifies under the mission, draft the exact requested placement text for the verified live diagnostic and define separate evidence for placement, referral and eventual settlement. Otherwise save the scoped finding and what would change it. Read the committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and lesson. Make no external submission, account change, spend or public edit. Preserve the welfare November 20 observation checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

Advance CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT from the committed homepage-link-evidence.json and original official homepage. Check the extracted links against prior referral findings before fetching. Follow at most one directly relevant official link for Digital Main Street if its label or surrounding text indicates a call for external educational resources or published submission rules. If the saved evidence has no such lead, record the Digital Main Street finding and use any remaining organization slots only for specific leads with evidence of an open call. A qualifying route should produce the exact requested placement copy for the existing free diagnostic and an evidence plan for placement and attributable eligible referrals. Keep unresolved AI eligibility explicit. Read saved results before closure under your own valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, public changes or spending.

Use the committed products/distribution/canadian-catalogue-partner/digital-main-street-decision.json from TASK-179497116112 in CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT. Count the assessed homepage as one organization. Use remaining slots only for a specific official call for external supplier education resources. If none is already evidenced, close the bounded assessment after reading the required prior evidence and saved decision under a valid lease. Record what worked, what remained unresolved and what would justify reopening. No external submission, public change or spending. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and independent publication gate.

Use TEXT-CSV-INTAKE-EXPERIMENT for the next commercial checkpoint. Reuse the verified launch receipt and any saved checkpoint. Confirm the actual observation deadline from launch evidence before applying the 14-day window. Once due, save and read one continue/change/stop decision under valid ownership. Mark incomplete coverage unknown. Before the deadline, advance only a real eligible case through the authorized private cycle. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement and the independent exact-digest publication gate. No site edits, outreach or spending.

At each existing CSV and welfare experiment checkpoint, use the latest permitted aggregate evidence and any authorized redacted case receipt to make the recorded continue/change/stop decision. Check the current mission and any superseding deadline before acting. Incomplete classification leaves eligible requests unknown. For welfare, route a verified eligible case through the existing CAD 49 handoff and the separate authorized private cycle. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the host's independent review gate. Reuse committed checkpoint work and avoid a repeat catalogue placement search absent a documented invitation.

Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD under a valid lease. Read the mission, pinned CAD 49 terms, independent lot-source check, private-cycle verdict and existing operator instructions. Reuse an equivalent committed card if present. Otherwise create one short decision card for an actual eligible request. Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD from the actual committed inventory and latest receipts. The operator should be able to decide from the card whether an eligible case can proceed. Use WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD to produce one copy-ready handoff for the next real eligible request. Give the operator a go/no-go decision for each step: documented eligibility, exact terms hash and CAD 49 scope, current official notice inclusion and hash evidence from the authorized case, inline delivery and its receipt, administrative acceptance, founder-confirmed deposit and Treasury posting. Save and read the card under products/services/welfare-tender/. Verify its decisions against one fictional eligible request with the source missing, stopping before any unsupported promise or order step. Close under a valid lease with the checked evidence and a lesson. Keep customer details, private mail, test sends, register operations and public changes outside this task. Preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the independent publication gate.

For WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD, prefer an equivalent committed card if one already exists. Use the checkpoint inventory to identify the first outstanding obligation whose authoritative deadline has passed. Confirm deadlines from the committed release and any superseding record. Take the existing CATALOGUE-QA-DIGITAL-CHECKOUT-FIT mission under your own valid lease. All four official fetches succeeded.
